text: [laughter] Oh Fennel, you remembered the cat's name. That's real loyalty right there.
[laughter] Sprocket says Scar looks like a grumpy uncle. Honestly, that's exactly who he's.
[laughter] I keep saying I'll stop naming the chickens. I named three more today.
[laughter] Wait, Juniper's here and Moss is here. The old crew is back together.
[laughter] Biscuit asked if the muffalo has a name. Of course she does, she's called Pancake.
[laughter] Pickle thinks Bram has a crush on the trader. Chat, I think Pickle might be right.
[laughter] Every time Socks wanders into the hospital, the doctor stops to pet her. That's terrible for efficiency. I'm never going to fix it, because it's the sweetest thing in this whole colony.
[laughter] Odessa keeps leaving flowers on my desk in the game, and I keep pretending it's a bug. It's not a bug, she just likes me. I'm choosing to believe that with my whole heart.
[laughter] I asked chat to name the new colonist and Biscuit said Biscuit Junior. I said no. Then fifty of you typed it at once, so now we officially have a Biscuit Junior.

[laughter] Okay, chat, Pancake the muffalo just wandered into the dining room again, right in the middle of dinner. Everyone's laughing and feeding her bread. Nobody is working, not even Bram. I've completely lost control, and I'm weirdly happy about it.

[laughter] Thimble, you came back just to tell me your cat is also named Socks? That's amazing, honestly. I think our cats are spiritually connected across the internet somehow. Do you think they'd get along if they ever met in real life?

[laughter] Okay, Juno just tried to give Socks a bath in the kitchen sink. Socks said no, loudly, and ran. Juno is now completely soaked and the cat is perfectly dry on the counter. Honestly, this is the best thing I've seen all week.
[laughter] Pip just introduced Socks to the new colonist like she's royalty.
[laughter] Bram knitted Pancake a sweater, and she actually looks thrilled.
[laughter] Rook just waved at the camera, I swear he knows you're watching.
[laughter] Mara caught Scar sneaking cookies and just handed him two more.
[laughter] Of course Juniper remembered the rubber duck lore.
[laughter] Biscuit Junior is officially Pip's shadow now.
[laughter] Tamsin tried to sing at the party. It was terrible, and everyone clapped anyway.
[laughter] Socks is sleeping on Scar's head. He's choosing not to move, which says everything.
[laughter] Arlo asked Rook if the gate goes to grandma's house. Rook said maybe, and I love him for it.
[laughter] Me getting choked up over a goat birth again. without fail.
[laughter] Scar lost at cards to Arlo three times. He swears he let him win.
[laughter] Pancake keeps following Juno into the kitchen. She thinks she's a colonist now.
[laughter] Me pretending I'm not emotional while my voice cracks. Classic.

[laughter] Quick story while the crops grow, chat. Last night Pip snuck Socks into bed, and Socks snuck out to sleep on Scar instead. Scar woke up with a cat on his face. He still claims he didn't smile, but I saw it.
[laughter] Snowball fight in the yard, and Scar is losing badly.
[laughter] Me, a grown woman, waving at a pixel muffalo.
[laughter] Arlo tried to ride Pancake. Pancake just sat down and refused to move.
[laughter] Nope, not crying at a kitten. Totally not.
[laughter] Socks is asleep in my lap, so we're not moving for a while.
[laughter] Pixel just named the pig Sir Bacon, and honestly, approved.
[laughter] My cat just sneezed on the microphone, sorry everyone.
[laughter] Wren voted for the name Gerald and now it's Gerald forever.
[laughter] Biscuit just admitted she's watching from bed, and same honestly.
[laughter] Lantern called my base adorable chaos and I'm keeping it.
[laughter] Pixel says my cat should get a sub badge, and I agree.
[laughter] Socks is chasing the cursor on my screen again. She thinks it's a bug.
[laughter] Socks is sitting on the warm laptop like it's her throne. I've lost my workspace forever.
[laughter] Pixel called the new freezer the cold castle. That's officially its name now.
[laughter] Rook tripped over the cat in the game and my real cat looked offended. It's a family thing.
[laughter] Wren suggested we name the gate Kevin. I'm so tempted.
[laughter] Socks just hissed at a raid on my screen. She's defending the colony.
[laughter] Mara named the turkey Breakfast and I'm a little worried. Please don't tell the turkey.
[laughter] Nova asked if my cat has a stream schedule. She does, and it's chaos.
[laughter] I tried to name the dog Captain and Pixel vetoed it instantly. Chat has spoken.
[laughter] Juniper keeps sending cat facts while my cat ignores me. The irony is perfect.
[laughter] Wren just said Socks has better aim than Hollis. That's not wrong, sadly.
[laughter] Cobalt just told me his dog barks every time I say raid. Sorry, buddy.
[laughter] Nova named the new chicken Meeting and now every time it clucks I panic. Thanks, Nova.
[laughter] Socks just walked in front of the camera like she owns the channel. Technically, she kind of does.
[laughter] Biscuit asked if my cat ever raids my snacks. She's raiding them as we speak.
[laughter] Juniper said I sound like a proud mom every time Pip does anything. Guilty.

[laughter] Socks just tried to catch the cursor again and knocked my headphones off the desk. She looked at me like it was my fault. Honestly, maybe it was. I'm going to go put the headphones back on and pretend that didn't happen.

Pixel just suggested we name the new turret Cuddles. It's a machine gun, Pixel, but you know what, I love it. Cuddles it's. Rook already painted a little heart on the barrel, so it's too late to change anything. [laughter]
[laughter] Juniper just pointed out that every animal on this map is named after a snack. Toast, Biscuit the goat, Pretzel, and now Waffle. In my defense, I was hungry again and again.

[laughter] Pixel just reminded me that I once named a colonist after my cat by accident. I typed Socks into the wrong box and never fixed it. That poor guy lived his whole life as Socks the Second. Honestly, he was a legend.

[laughter] Lantern's been naming every raider that attacks us after a vegetable. So far we've fought Carrot, Turnip, and a very angry Celery. Honestly, it makes the raids weirdly less scary for everyone. Keep them coming, Lantern, the colony depends on it.

[laughter] Odessa just tried to tame a squirrel for the fourth time today. It bit her, ran off, then came back and sat next to her. I think they're friends now in their own weird way. Chat, please help me name the squirrel.

[laughter] Juniper says my cat has more stream fans than I do, and looking at chat right now, she's right. Every time she walks past the camera, chat explodes. I'm just the opening act for Socks. Honestly, I'm fine with that.
[laughter] Pip just walked into the freezer to take a nap.
Scar has been carrying the same rock around for two days now. [laughter]
Okay so I built the bedroom with no door. [laughter] They're just stuck in there admiring the wallpaper.
[laughter] Socks the cat has more kills than my entire security team.
Wait, I put the hospital beds inside the kitchen. [laughter] That's a choice I made earlier today, apparently.
Biscuit in chat says Odessa looks like a disappointed librarian, and that's accurate. [laughter]
[laughter] Moss suggested we build a moat full of chairs, and I'm considering it.
Async Industries sent me a form asking why I filled out the previous form. [laughter]
Ivy drafted herself into a fistfight with a squirrel. [laughter] She lost, by the way.
[laughter] I just sold our only bed to a trader because I misclicked.
Rook is having a mental break because his chair was slightly ugly. [laughter] Same, honestly.
Hold on, the company memo says please stop feeding the room. [laughter] Feeding it what, exactly?
Mara insulted a visiting trader's hat and now they won't sell us potatoes. [laughter]
[laughter] Bram has just declared war on a turkey.
[laughter] Odessa went into the anomaly room, came back, and immediately asked for a sandwich.
Static Fern says I play like a raccoon running a business. [laughter] Fair, honestly, very fair.
Cobalt suggested we hire the raiders, and the company form for that actually exists. [laughter]
I zoned the trash pile as a recreation area, and everyone's thrilled about it. [laughter]
Okay so the company wants a quarterly report on my emotional stability. [laughter] I'm going to lie on it.
[laughter] Hollis ate the fancy meal I was saving for the wedding, and then he went to bed. Like nothing happened.
Wren just asked if the cat outranks me, and technically, yes. [laughter]
[laughter] Everybody survived that raid, and I genuinely don't know how.
[laughter] We did it, the power's back on.
[laughter] Honestly, I was ready to restart, and then everyone just pulled through.
Scar woke up from surgery and the first thing he did was ask for dessert. [laughter]
Okay, the bridge is finished, and nobody fell in the river this time. [laughter]
[laughter] Our company approved my form on the first try, which has never happened before.
[laughter] We beat the infestation, and Ivy only screamed twice.

Okay so here's what happened. I told Pip to haul the wood, and she hauled the wood straight into the river. Then she stood on the bank watching it float away, very proud of herself, like a little captain. [laughter] I honestly can't even be upset with her.

[laughter] Chat, you have to hear this one. The company sent a twelve page form about the wrong color of paperclip. There is an entire section for my personal feelings about the paperclip. I wrote that I feel fine about it and signed it twice.

So Scar decided the best way to fight the raid was to throw his shoe at them. [laughter] It didn't work, obviously, it bounced off a wall. He is now down one shoe and still incredibly confident about it. Someone please go find his shoe for him.

This room in the Backrooms is a whole dentist's waiting room with no dentist anywhere. There is elevator music, a tiny fish tank and a sign saying please wait to be called. We waited. [laughter] Nothing happened for an hour, and somehow that was the scariest part of the whole trip.

Okay, I need a second, because that was way too close. The east wall was gone, Mara was down, and the raiders were right there at the door. And then Juno just held the line by herself with a pistol. [laughter] I'm so proud of her I could scream.

Wren asked what the colony motto is, and I said we try our best. [laughter] Then I looked over at the burning kitchen and quietly changed it. Now the official motto is just we try, with nothing after it. That's the whole motto, and I stand by it.
Bram just put on a dress he found in a dead raider's pack. [laughter] He's wearing it to dinner.
Mara has been yelling at a door for an hour. [laughter] Is she winning?
I'm not giving them my blood type. [laughter] Why would a lumber order even need that?
Chat, look away for one second. [laughter] I need to fix the roof I forgot.
So the new room behind gate four is just an endless ball pit. [laughter] Rook refuses to come out.
Relax, Odessa's fine. [laughter] She's just pretending to be a statue again.
Cobalt says the turkey is our real leader now. [laughter] I'm not even going to fight that.
He looks so betrayed in there. [laughter] I built a wall around the wrong colonist.
Hollis tried to flirt with a visiting trader by showing her a rock. [laughter] It almost worked.
Tamsin just threw another grenade backwards. [laughter] Who taught her that?
My grand plan was to lure the raiders into a trap. [laughter] I forgot to build the trap.
Somebody take the shovel away from Scar. [laughter] He's digging toward nothing with great purpose.
Corporate sent a thank you card for the incident report. [laughter] Then they sent an incident report about the card.
Our welcome mat is the best security we've. [laughter] Did that raider really just trip over it?
Juniper wants me to rename the colony Snack Town. [laughter] Honestly, it fits better than the current name.
Ivy, that grizzly isn't a pet. [laughter] Okay, now it's a pet, apparently.
This Backrooms room is a gym with no equipment, just mirrors and one sad treadmill. [laughter] Juno is running on it anyway.
Don't panic, the screaming is just Bram learning to cook. [laughter] It's normal now.
Nova suggested we fight the mechanoids with kindness. [laughter] Pip tried, and she's now in bed with three bruises.
Asking for Odessa here. [laughter] What's the point of a filing cabinet that files you?
I asked Rook to clean the bedroom, and he cleaned it by setting it on fire. [laughter] Technically, it's very clean now.
Last time Moss named a muffalo, we got Mister Steve Potato. [laughter] Should I let him name the next one?
He cried. [laughter] Pip gave her best friend a single dandelion for his birthday and he actually cried.
Mara's walking around in a full suit of armor to pick berries. [laughter] Safety first, I guess.
Pixel, please stop suggesting we eat the couch. [laughter] It's leather, but still.
Static Fern says I'm the worst general in history. [laughter] That's fair, I just drafted the cat.
Async Industries wants a signed form saying I read the form. [laughter] I didn't read either one.
She walked into the same door twice. [laughter] How is Tamsin this good at shooting but this bad at doors?
It actually has better armor than the helmet. [laughter] Scar is wearing a bucket on his head now.
Lantern just asked if the anomaly is friendly. [laughter] It ate a chair, so I'm going to say medium friendly.
It's alright, Hollis, everyone falls into the river sometimes. [laughter] Well, not everyone, just you.
This room has a clock on every wall, and they all say different times. [laughter] I've decided it's lunch.
Somebody just ran screaming into the lake. [laughter] Was that one of mine?
Biscuit wants to know my strategy, and I'm going to be honest. [laughter] I click things and hope.
Juno refuses to eat at a table that's slightly crooked. [laughter] She has standards I can't afford.
Bram offered her a used boot. [laughter] Now the trader is literally running away from his sales pitch.
Wren's suggestion is that we build a giant statue of Socks. [laughter] I've already queued it.
I zoned the cows into the dining room by mistake. [laughter] Now they're eating with us every night.
Oh, the freezer door is open again. [laughter] Which genius did that?
The company's new policy says every gate must be greeted politely. [laughter] Rook said hello to it, and it closed on him.
There's nothing wrong with it, and that's the problem. [laughter] Is it weird that the creepiest room is a really clean bathroom?
It took four tries. [laughter] Ivy finally beat the squirrel in a rematch.
Odessa won't stop telling the prisoner bad jokes. [laughter] He's begging us to release him.
Corporate sent an apology letter for the last apology letter. [laughter] It had typos in it.
You're okay, Pip, the turkey's gone now. [laughter] We'll never speak of it again.
Cobalt says I should build a moat around the moat. [laughter] I hate that I'm tempted.
We just traded a pile of wooden chairs for a full set of power armor. [laughter] Best deal I've ever made.
Phew, the cold snap is over. [laughter] Everybody's toes are still attached.
Scar walked out of the Backrooms with two new friends and a bag of gold. [laughter] I don't know how, but I'm not asking.
Our past selves did something right. [laughter] How lucky are we that the raid hit the empty barracks?
We finally have hot showers in this colony. [laughter] Morale is through the roof.
Oh, we're rich now. [laughter] Did the trader really accept that offer?
After the third collapse, we finally have a mine shaft that stays up. [laughter] I'm emotional about a ceiling.
Ivy got her first kill and then apologized to it. [laughter] I love her so much.
Hollis finally recovered from the plague. [laughter] He's acting like nothing happened.
Wren predicted we'd survive the raid, and we actually did. [laughter] Chat called it.

Okay, can I tell you about the paperwork? Async Industries wants me to log every time a colonist sneezes. There's a separate form for loud sneezes and quiet sneezes. [laughter] I've been filling it out for twenty minutes, and Pip has sneezed eleven times.

So I left Rook in charge for one single in game day. [laughter] When I came back, he had built three statues of himself and nothing else. No beds, no food, no walls, just Rook everywhere. I'm impressed and also a little worried about him.
Behind the newest gate there's a laundromat where every machine is running and nobody's there. [laughter] Juno put her shirt in one and it came out folded. Now she wants to live there forever.
Lantern suggested we make friends with the raiders by throwing a party. [laughter] I set up a table with snacks and everything. They showed up, ate all the snacks, and then raided us anyway.

Chat, I genuinely thought that was the end of the run. The power was out, the heaters were down and everybody was freezing. Then the trade caravan showed up with fuel at the last second. [laughter] I've never loved a stranger more.
Pixel asked me why the kitchen has three doors. [laughter] Honestly, I forgot why, and now we have three doors.
[laughter] Rook just challenged a mechanoid to a staring contest.
Did the company seriously send us a fax machine through the gate? [laughter]
Should we tell Mara the haunted painting is just a mirror? [laughter]
Fun fact, I had no idea that wall was load bearing. [laughter]
Pixel, your idea worked, and I'm furious about it. [laughter]
Unbelievable. [laughter] Did the turkey just steal Pip's hat?
Nova, you can't vote for chaos every time, like a ritual. [laughter] Okay, fine, chaos wins.
Socks has been promoted, I guess. [laughter] Why else would there be a corporate memo taped to the cat?
Tamsin built a snowman during a raid. [laughter] To be fair, it absorbed two bullets.
Chat, help me find Hollis, he's somewhere in the ball pit room. [laughter] Look for a hat.
Mara is hiding from the soup again. [laughter] Can a colonist actually be scared of soup?
Look at Scar trying to sneak past the raiders in a cardboard box. [laughter] It's working.
Seven forms, and we still don't have the shovel. [laughter] How many more does corporate want from us?
Don't worry about Ivy, she always sleeps on the roof. [laughter] It's her thing.
Cobalt dared me to let Rook cook the wedding dinner. [laughter] Everyone survived, but barely.
I'm the manager. [laughter] Should I be offended that the trader asked to speak to my manager?
Odessa, stop trying to recruit the raiders mid fight. [laughter] Shoot them first, then chat.
Bram is teaching the muffalo to dance. [laughter] Somebody clip this.

Okay so I paused the game to think and then forgot what I was thinking about. It's been five minutes. [laughter] Chat, please tell me what I was doing, because the raiders are still standing right there waiting very politely.

Static Fern suggested we let the colonists vote on everything for a day. [laughter] They voted for a nap, then dessert, then another nap. Honestly, it was the most peaceful day this colony has ever had, and nothing got built.
Corporate wants a written explanation for why the gate is humming in the key of B flat. [laughter] I wrote that it's a musical gate. They approved it and asked if it takes requests.

There's a Backrooms room that's entirely made of carpet, including the ceiling and the furniture. Pip lay down on the floor and refused to get up. [laughter] I don't blame her, it looked like the comfiest place in the universe.

Moss asked for a dramatic speech before the raid, so I gave one. [laughter] Halfway through it, Hollis wandered off to eat berries. That was the whole army listening, by the way, which says a lot about my leadership.

Chat, I have a very serious question for you tonight. Why does every single colonist I recruit come with a deep passion for burning things down? [laughter] Is it me, is it something about my vibe? Do I just attract this kind of energy on purpose?

So the company sent us a motivational poster straight through the gate. [laughter] It says teamwork makes the dream work, and it's printed upside down. Juno hung it up in the barracks anyway, right over the beds. Now everyone salutes it on the way to breakfast.

Okay, quick recap for anyone just joining. I set the farm on fire, Scar fought a goose, and we accidentally recruited a pirate. [laughter] Normal day. Honestly, a pretty good day by our standards, and the pirate is very nice.

Lantern wanted to know why Bram carries a teapot into every fight. [laughter] Long story short, he refuses to fight without tea. The worst part is he hasn't lost a single fight since he started doing it, so who am I to say anything.

Something just knocked on our front door, waited politely and then left a little note. [laughter] It was the anomaly, by the way. I genuinely want chat's opinion here. Should we read the note, or is that exactly how it gets us?
[laughter] The raiders gave up and went home.
Oh, the drop pods landed right in our storage area. [laughter] Free supplies.
I'm so proud of her. [laughter] Did everyone see Ivy catch that grenade and throw it right back?
That's amazing, honestly. [laughter] Are you telling me nobody got hurt in that ambush?
Biscuit, you raided us with forty people. [laughter] Welcome, everyone.
Finally, after two seasons of trying, the solar array is fully online. [laughter] Every light in the base is on, and Juno keeps flipping switches just to watch them glow. Honestly, I'm doing it too.

So the trader came in wanting our old furniture. [laughter] I sold her three wobbly chairs and a broken lamp. In return we got a bionic leg, two crates of medicine and a very nice hat. Best trade of the year, easily.

That blizzard nearly got us, honestly. The heaters were failing and the firewood was running out fast. Then Bram found an old stash of chemfuel behind the shed. [laughter] He's officially the colony hero, and he won't stop reminding everyone about it.
Wren, thank you for the bits. [laughter] You picked the perfect moment, the ship reactor just finished building and everyone is cheering in the hall. This is the best night we've had in forever.

Okay so the expedition team found a room full of free supplies in the Backrooms. It had steel, components and even a fancy rug. [laughter] For once, the scary place gave us presents, and I'm choosing not to question it.
Can anyone explain why Scar is wearing two left gloves? [laughter]
[laughter] That trader just bought our garbage pile.
Did Bram seriously just bow to the raiders before shooting them? [laughter] Was that manners?
There's a form for requesting a second form. [laughter] I filled out both.
Wow, look at me, misclicking with total confidence like a classic. [laughter]
Juniper, quit cheering for the raiders. [laughter] They don't even have a theme song.
Static Fern keeps asking for a pet rock, so Rook gave him one on stream. [laughter] It's named Kevin now.
Moss bet me I couldn't go one day without starting a fire. [laughter] I lasted until lunch.
Pixel predicted the raid would come at dinner, and it did. [laughter] I'm hiring Pixel as our oracle.

Our emergency plan is apparently to scream and run. [laughter] Wait, who wrote that plan? Oh, that was me again, a whole month ago, at three in the morning. Does anyone in chat want to write a better plan for us?

Real talk, chat, I just spent ten minutes designing the perfect kill box. Then I sent everyone the wrong direction and they all walked right out of it. [laughter] The raiders were confused, we were confused, and somehow we still won.

Corporate sent an inspector to check our safety standards. [laughter] He arrived just as Rook was juggling grenades in the kitchen. He wrote one word on his clipboard, and it was wow. Then he asked to stay for dinner, so I guess we passed.

Can I share a small confession with chat? I've been calling the muffalo by the wrong name for about forty days. Everyone in the colony knew and nobody told me. [laughter] So her name is officially Lulu now, and she seems fine with it.
Cobalt wants to know if Hollis has ever won a single fight. [laughter] Honestly, I had to check his log. He's lost to a squirrel, a goose and a closed door. Does a tie with a snowman count as a win?

Nova suggested we build the entire base out of doors, and I did it. [laughter] Now every wall opens, and the raiders keep wandering in confused. Somehow the colonists love it, and Pip uses a different door every day just because she can.
Is that a full stack of plasteel? [laughter]
I'll take that deal forever. [laughter] Did that caravan really trade us a horse for some berries?
The ship's engine is finally installed. [laughter] We're actually going to space.
Bram finally cooked a meal that nobody complained about. [laughter] Historic night.
The quest reward was way bigger than I thought. [laughter] Where did all this silver come from?
Wow, that went so well. [laughter] I almost don't trust it.
Everybody go enjoy the hot springs tonight. [laughter] No work allowed.
We're fine, I promise, the fire stayed in the kitchen. [laughter] Mostly.
Juno taught Pip how to paint, and Pip's first piece is excellent. [laughter] Teacher is a little jealous.
Corporate approved our expansion permit. [laughter] Took three weeks, but we're official.
That trader took our spare blankets and gave us a whole crate of medicine. [laughter] Winter's looking a lot friendlier now.
Ivy's prosthetic hand finally works, and the first thing she did was wave at me. [laughter] I'm not crying, you're crying.
After so many tries, the deep drill finally hit steel. [laughter] Rook cheered so loud it scared the chickens, and I don't even care. We're going to have enough metal for the whole winter build list.

Behind the last gate there was a whole room of old corporate snacks, still sealed. [laughter] The crew brought back so many cookies that we're calling it a holiday now. Odessa wants it on the calendar forever.

Look at this, chat, the whole crew made it through the toxic winter. Not one person lost, not even the cat. Every single colonist is healthy and fed. [laughter] I keep checking the list because I can't believe it, but it's true.

So remember the trader who laughed at our goods last week? He came back today and begged to buy our sculptures. [laughter] I charged him triple, and he paid it. Honestly, that felt like the best victory of the whole stream so far.

We finally finished the great bridge across the river after three failed tries. Pip was the first one to walk across, and she did a little dance in the middle. Then everyone followed her and danced too. [laughter] Best ribbon cutting ceremony ever.

Hey, everyone, I want to say something quick. That was the closest call we've had in a long time, and I really thought Scar was gone. He woke up an hour ago and asked for pancakes. [laughter] I've never been happier to make pancakes in my life.

Tonight the company finally paid out the big contract. That's enough silver to buy power armor for everyone, plus a fancy rug for the hall. Juno asked for a disco ball, and honestly, I'm considering it. [laughter] We've earned a little fun after this week.

Phew, okay, the harvest is done. Every crop came in before the frost, the freezer is stuffed and Bram is already planning a feast. [laughter] I'm going to let him cook just this once. What could possibly go wrong at this point?

Just finished building the observatory, and it took us almost a full year. Hollis is up there right now pointing at stars and naming them after chat. [laughter] There's a Biscuit star and a Nova star already. I love this crew so much.
Legendary plasma sword, chat, a legendary plasma sword. [laughter]
[laughter] I can't believe the event letter was a party invite.
Tamsin just sang to the raiders and they left, I'm screaming. [laughter]
[laughter] Bram just danced through the mud and nobody asked him to.
Nova raided with sixty people and I'm losing my mind. [laughter]
[laughter] Mara named the new muffalo after me and I'm honored.
[laughter] No way, the raid turned around and left.
[laughter] Rook fell asleep in the middle of a fight, unbelievable.
[laughter] Bram ate the cake meant for the wedding.
[laughter] Socks the cat is wearing a helmet now, how.
[laughter] He tripped and the raiders tripped too.
[laughter] Chat, we did it. The legendary crossbow is ours.
[laughter] Pip is doing a victory dance on the turret. He earned that, let him dance.
[laughter] Socks caught a rat in the new level. Our cat is officially a Backrooms hunter.
[laughter] Level eight has free stuff everywhere. We're going to be so rich.
[laughter] Lantern's raid just showed up mid sentence. Hi, hi, welcome, you're all amazing.
[laughter] Moss named a muffalo Unity Junior. I'm so honored right now.
[laughter] Okay, I'm way too hyped. Somebody take my coffee away.
[laughter] Tamsin outran the entire raid. She's literally faster than a bullet.
[laughter] Rook just won the wrestling contest. Pay up, Bram.
[laughter] Breathe, Unity. It's only the best stream of the year.
[laughter] Oh, the raiders brought us a gift basket. They're friendly, they're actually friendly.
[laughter] Socks just attacked a centipede. She actually won the fight.
[laughter] Wow, the raid tripped over our cat. The whole raid.
No, no, the thrumbo walked into our base by itself. It wants to live here. [laughter]
[laughter] Well, I didn't see that one coming. Not even a little.
[laughter] Biscuit, you raided at the exact second the gate exploded with confetti. Perfect timing.
[laughter] Scar married the trader. I leave for one minute.
[laughter] Nope, nope, I'm not reading that letter twice. That can't be right.
[laughter] Pixel just raided with eighty people right as the mechanoid hive woke up. Welcome, everybody, you picked the best possible moment. Grab a snack and watch our turrets go absolutely wild.

[laughter] Breathe, breathe, it's just a legendary item. Just a gorgeous, shiny, perfect legendary item that's now ours forever. Note to self, stop yelling into the microphone every time something good happens.
[laughter] Rook just walked straight up to the raid leader and offered him a bowl of soup. The raider took the soup and sat down by the fire. Did we just end a whole war with soup?
[laughter] Mara tried to tame a squirrel and accidentally tamed a whole bear instead. It's following her around like a puppy now. She's named it Pancake and nobody can stop her.

[laughter] Chat, Pip just came back from level nine wearing a crown. He says he won a tournament against the hallway creatures. I don't know if that's true, but he does have a trophy. Can we make him the official colony champion?

[laughter] Hold on, I just checked the event letter twice. The company is giving us a bonus for being the best colony in the sector. That means new furniture, new weapons, and a whole new research bench. I can't stop smiling.
